extension.description: A beautiful PDF reader with smart dark mode and a ClickUp-style notes & task outliner backed by plain Markdown.
editor.pdfViewer.title: PaperDesk PDF
view.container.title: PaperDesk
view.notes.title: Notes & Tasks
config.notes.folderName: Folder inside the workspace where notes are stored as Markdown files.
config.notes.saveDebounceMs: How long to wait after the last edit before writing a note to disk, in milliseconds.
config.notes.confirmBeforeDelete: Ask for confirmation before deleting a note or a task that has subtasks.
config.notes.cascadeCompletion: What to do with subtasks when a parent task is checked.
config.notes.cascadeCompletion.ask: Ask each time whether to check the subtasks too.
config.notes.cascadeCompletion.always: Always check every subtask along with the parent.
config.notes.cascadeCompletion.never: Only check the parent and leave subtasks untouched.
config.pdf.defaultTheme: Reading theme used when a PDF is opened for the first time. `auto` follows the current VS Code color theme.
config.pdf.defaultTheme.auto: Follow the active VS Code color theme.
config.pdf.defaultTheme.light: Always open PDFs in light mode.
config.pdf.defaultTheme.dark: Always open PDFs in dark mode.
config.pdf.defaultTheme.sepia: Always open PDFs in sepia mode.
config.pdf.zoomStep: How much each zoom in/out step changes the scale.
config.pdf.renderWindow: How many pages above and below the viewport to keep rendered. Higher values scroll more smoothly but use more memory.
config.pdf.maxCanvasPixels: Upper bound on the pixel area of a single rendered page. Protects against enormous pages at high zoom.
config.pdf.restoreLastPage: Reopen each PDF at the page you last read.
config.pdf.textLayer: Render a selectable text layer over each page, enabling text selection, copying and search.
config.pdf.dark.filter: CSS filter applied to the page canvas in dark mode. A partial invert keeps white pages a soft charcoal rather than harsh black; `hue-rotate(180deg)` puts colors back on their original hue.
config.pdf.dark.pageBackground: Color painted behind the page in dark mode, before the filter is applied. Only shows through on PDFs whose pages are transparent.
config.pdf.dark.protectImages: Re-invert photos and figures in dark mode so they keep their true colors instead of looking like negatives.
config.pdf.dark.minProtectedImageArea: Smallest image area, in square CSS pixels, that is worth protecting in dark mode. Tiny images are usually icons or rules and look better inverted with the text.
config.pdf.dark.maxProtectedImageCoverag: Images covering more than this fraction of a page are treated as a scanned page or background and inverted with the text rather than protected, so scanned documents still read in dark mode.
config.pdf.sepia.filter: CSS filter applied to the page canvas in sepia mode.
config.pdf.sepia.pageBackground: Color painted behind the page in sepia mode, before the filter is applied.
config.export.browserPath: Absolute path to a Chrome, Chromium, Edge or Brave executable used to print exported notes to PDF. Leave empty to detect one automatically.
config.export.pageFormat: Paper size used when exporting notes to PDF.
config.export.margin: Page margin for PDF export, written as a CSS `@page` margin value.
config.export.includeCompleted: Include completed tasks in exported documents.
config.export.includeFrontmatter: Include each note's YAML frontmatter in the exported Markdown.
config.export.theme: Color theme for exported and previewed documents.
config.export.accentColor: Accent color used for headings, progress bars and links in exported documents.
